message: The last time a storm was headed our way, I thought I was being clever by waiting until the last minute to stock up on snacks. Turns out, everyone else had the same idea—so instead of chips, I ended up with a cart full of kale and kombucha. Lesson learned: next time, I might just keep a stash of comfort food handy, because nothing beats the comedy of unpreparedness during a storm. What’s your go-to storm snack?
